parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The number of the page to return. Pages start from page 1. Default value: 1.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page. Maximum value: 100. Default value: 10.

parameters.name: PluginType
parameters.description: The business type of the plug-in.

parameters.name: Tag
parameters.description: The tag of objects that match the lifecycle rule. You can specify multiple tags.
